name: Google Cloud Text-to-Speech
positioning: Google Cloud's text-to-speech API with a wide voice and language catalogue spanning Standard voices, WaveNet and Neural2, Chirp 3 HD voices, instant custom voices and token-priced Gemini-TTS models.

pricing.model: Per character sent (SSML tags count, except the mark tag) with monthly free allowances per voice type; Gemini-TTS models are priced per million text and audio tokens.
pricing.headline: Standard voices $4 per 1M characters (first 4M characters per month free); Neural2 $16; Chirp 3: HD $30; Studio $160; Instant custom voice $60.

tiers.name: Standard voices
tiers.notes: Free: 0 to 4 million characters per month.

tiers.name: WaveNet voices
tiers.notes: Page lists the same SKU id as Standard and the same $4 price; free 0 to 4 million characters per month. See the list of things we could not confirm below.

tiers.name: Neural2 voices
tiers.notes: Free: 0 to 1 million characters per month.

tiers.name: Polyglot (Preview) voices
tiers.notes: Free: 0 to 1 million characters per month.

tiers.name: Studio voices
tiers.notes: Free: 0 to 1 million characters per month.

tiers.name: Chirp 3: HD voices
tiers.notes: Free: 0 to 1 million characters per month. No SSML, speaking rate or pitch parameters.

tiers.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS (Preview)
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $0.50 text input, $9.00 audio output through 2026-12-31; $1.00 and $18.00 from 2027-01-01
tiers.notes: Audio tokens are 25 per second of audio. Token-billed, so no per-character price.

tiers.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS (Preview)
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $0.50 text input, $6.00 audio output through 2026-12-31; $1.00 and $12.00 from 2027-01-01

tiers.name: Gemini 2.5 Flash TTS / Flash-Lite Preview TTS
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $0.50 text input, $10.00 audio output

tiers.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS (Preview)
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $1.00 text input, $20.00 audio output

tiers.name: Gemini 2.5 Pro TTS
tiers.unit: USD per 1M tokens: $1.00 text input, $20.00 audio output

pricing.freeTier: Monthly free characters: 4 million for Standard and WaveNet voices; 1 million each for Neural2, Polyglot (Preview), Studio and Chirp 3: HD. No free allowance for Instant custom voice or Gemini-TTS. New Google Cloud customers also get $300 in free credits (stated on the bidirectional streaming quickstart).
promotions: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS (Preview) list a lower price through 2026-12-31 and double on 2027-01-01 (text input $0.50 to $1.00; Flash audio output $9 to $18; Flash-Lite audio output $6 to $12 per 1M tokens).

voices.count: 380+ voices (product page); Chirp 3: HD voices come in 30 distinct styles
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Chirp 3: Instant Custom Voice creates a personal voice from a recording; a consent statement in the speaker's language ('I am the owner of this voice and I consent to Google using this voice...') is required. Supports streaming and several languages; priced at $60 per 1M characters. Access conditions beyond that were not stated on the page read.

streaming.note: Google documents bidirectional streaming synthesis as a Preview feature under Pre-GA terms; whether the transport is WebSocket or HTTP was not confirmed on the pages read

compatibility.note: Native API is POST https://texttospeech.googleapis.com/v1/text:synthesize with input, voice (languageCode, name) and audioConfig (audioEncoding); OAuth or Google credentials rather than an OpenAI-style bearer key. No OpenAI-compatible mode found in the pages read. SSML is supported on most voice types but not Chirp 3: HD.

licensing.commercialUse: Quotas page: audio files created with the service may be used in applications or media in compliance with the Google Cloud Platform Terms of Service and applicable law.

limits.perRequestCharacters: 5,000 bytes per request (multi-byte characters such as ja-JP use more than one byte)
limits.concurrency: Quotas per project: 100 concurrent streaming sessions; 200 requests per minute for Chirp 3; 500 for Studio; 1,000 for Neural2, Polyglot and default voices; 30 per minute for Chirp voice cloning. Gemini-TTS 2.5: 150 (Flash) and 125 (Pro) queries per minute. Limits subject to change.

sdks: Google Cloud client libraries (languages not enumerated in pages read)

compliance.note: No product-specific compliance statements found on the Text-to-Speech pages read; Google Cloud publishes compliance information at the platform level that was not reviewed here.

strengths.claim: Broad catalogue: 380+ voices across 75+ languages and variants.
Entry price: Standard and WaveNet voices at $4 per 1M characters with 4M free characters per month.
Chirp 3: HD voices (30 styles), which Google describes as designed for conversational agents with low-latency streaming, plus an instant custom voice option with a consent statement.
SSML support on Studio, Neural2, WaveNet and Standard voices, and output formats including MULAW and ALAW for telephony.
Gemini-TTS models give text-prompt control over delivery.

limitations.claim: Chirp 3: HD voices do not support SSML input, speaking rate and pitch parameters, or A-law encoding.
Bidirectional streaming synthesis is documented as a Preview feature under Pre-GA terms.

stepsToMove: Google uses POST /v1/text:synthesize with JSON {input:{text|ssml}, voice:{languageCode, name}, audioConfig:{audioEncoding}}; each call site builds this body.
Google uses OAuth access tokens or service-account credentials rather than an API key; find where your code obtains them.
List the voice names you use (for example en-US-Chirp3-HD-Charon or en-GB-Neural2-A) and the languageCode paired with each.
If input uses ssml, find every place that builds SSML (Chirp 3: HD voices do not accept SSML either).
audioEncoding values LINEAR16, MP3, OGG_OPUS, MULAW and ALAW are Google's names; list which ones you request.
Google counts SSML tags as characters (except mark), so character totals will differ if you stop sending markup.

mapping.note: The request body is different, so each call site is rewritten; Google uses OAuth or service-account credentials where ReadAloud uses an API key

bestFor: Teams already on Google Cloud, or teams that need broad language and voice coverage, with Standard and WaveNet voices at $4 per 1M characters and optional Chirp 3 HD voices.
unknowns: All Google prices are single-source (the pricing page); no second Google page repeated the numbers
WaveNet is listed at $4 per 1M characters with the same SKU id as Standard; this may be a pricing-page quirk, and we did not check the pricing calculator
Whether streaming is WebSocket or HTTP (bidirectional streaming doc is a Preview; transport not confirmed)
